quotes.text: The D329733 review request specified the console-owned headless Playwright browser for local web UI checks and the matching Thunderbird build with its headless test harness for Thunderbird chrome. This is a requested validation method, not evidence that either check ran for the current revision. Chromium results do not establish Thunderbird chrome behavior.
